components.css: .ds-agent-core{max-width:550px;padding:28px;border-radius:16px;background:#1b1625;color:#f8f5ff;font-family:Geist,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 34px 80px rgba(36,25,66,.25)}.ds-agent-core header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding-bottom:22px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}.ds-agent-core header>span:last-child{display:grid;gap:4px}.ds-agent-core header strong{font-size:.96rem}.ds-agent-core header small{color:#b8d9c7;font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-agent-core header i{display:inline-block;width:6px;height:6px;margin-right:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#7bd5a4}.ds-agent-mark{display:grid;place-items:center;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:14px;background:#7554e8;font-weight:800}.ds-agent-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 24px 1fr;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-top:22px}.ds-agent-row>span{display:grid;gap:4px;padding:12px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.055);font-size:.71rem;font-weight:600}.ds-agent-row small{color:#d9d2e3;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:400;line-height:1.4}.ds-agent-row svg{color:#a68af7}.ds-agent-core footer{margin-top:20px;padding-top:17px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#8f869b;font-size:.61rem}@media(max-width:520px){.ds-agent-core{padding:16px}.ds-agent-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ds-agent-row svg{transform:rotate(90deg);justify-self:center}}

narrative.overview: The Gro public website combines a concise six-chapter homepage with focused pages for process, capabilities, brand philosophy, business use cases, and contact. Newsreader headings, Geist evidence, warm paper, deep ink chapters, violet intelligence, lavender recommendations, and green readiness states show an agent that observes, understands, prepares, and stays accountable to people. This public specification is separate from the authenticated Client Dossier system.
keyCharacteristics: Warm editorial paper and strong light-dark chapter contrast.
Agent activity shown as signals, interpretation, preparation, and review.
Violet traces Gro through the experience; green marks attentive readiness.
Exact supplied logo in a clipped dark tile.
Meaningful route-specific motion with complete reduced-motion handling.
Distinct flow, operations, editorial, interactive, and conversion page personalities.

rules.name: The Violet Thread Rule
rules.body: Use violet to trace Gro's role through emphasis, processing, connection, and action without saturating every surface.

rules.name: The Editorial-to-Operational Rule
rules.body: Use Newsreader for propositions and interpretations, and Geist for facts, status, evidence, navigation, and controls.

rules.name: The One Focal Lift Rule
rules.body: Lift the current agent or action focal point and keep surrounding editorial material flat.

dos: Do preserve this document's public-website scope and the root design system's authenticated scope.
Do use the exact public/gro-logo.png asset in the established dark tile.
Do keep the homepage to six concise chapters and move detail to the relevant public route.
Do label example signals and simulated operating states as illustrative.
Do keep ready for human review distinct from executed or completed work.
Do preserve focus, minimum target size, keyboard, responsive, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't spread this public identity into authenticated, staff, or admin surfaces without a separate decision.
Don't redraw the public wordmark as text.
Don't use neon AI effects, futuristic motifs, or chart-first dashboard layouts.
Don't present illustrative content as live evidence, autonomous publishing, or guaranteed outcomes.
Don't recreate the full website as one long homepage or repeat one hero composition on every route.
